usedFor: AudioPod AI processes audio, such as transcription with speaker labels; Calendly handles scheduling. A finished or failed job in AudioPod AI could prompt a “Create One-Time Meeting” in Calendly, for example a review call about the result.

bestTemplate.name: “New Job Failed” in AudioPod AI, then “Create One-Time Meeting” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A failure is the case that most needs a conversation, so it offers a one-off slot to sort it out. Completed jobs rarely need a meeting.

watchOut: This pair suits low-volume work. Every job that matches “New Job Failed” or “New Job Completed” would make a meeting, so filter the trigger by job type first.
